latest.author: bystritskiy
latest.text: Done! The PS5 build is now based on SpeedBreaker v0.2.4, so it picks up Sharper UI (menus, HUD and text enlarged with a sharper filter at 4K instead of a blur) and Movie Upscaling for the cutscenes, plus Shadow Resolution, Cooler Colors and Cops in Quick Race. HDR won't be in it, unfortunately: the PS5's Vulkan layer the port runs on only presents SDR, so the HDR option has nothing to switch to. It's hidden on PS5 for now.

latest.author: bystritskiy
latest.text: Thanks for playing it all the way through, and for the detailed report! About HD textures: the app ships no game assets at all. Everything you see comes from your own disc, so the textures, UI and decals are the original Xbox 360 ones, and the 4K setting raises the rendering resolution, not the resolution of the assets themselves.
